tagline: Leading independent provider of home and alternate site infusion services
hero_kpi_rationale: Robust 13.0% year-over-year revenue growth, reflecting therapy portfolio expansion and market share gains in a consolidating sector

kpis.name: Net Revenue
kpis.description: Net revenue is a key indicator of company growth
kpis.signal: Revenue growth driven by organic expansion of the therapy portfolio and market share gains

kpis.name: Gross Profit
kpis.description: Gross profit represents net revenue less cost of revenue
kpis.signal: Gross profit increase due to revenue growth, partially offset by shifts in therapy mix

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Gross margin as a percentage of revenue
kpis.description: Gross margin represents gross profit as a percentage of net revenue
kpis.signal: Decline in gross margin due to therapy mix, including rare and orphan therapies, and biosimilar adoption

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.description: Operating income represents gross profit less operating expenses
kpis.signal: Operating income growth despite higher expenses related to portfolio expansion

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating margin as a percentage of revenue
kpis.description: Operating margin represents operating income as a percentage of net revenue
kpis.signal: Stable operating margin despite gross margin compression, reflecting operational leverage

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income represents profit after all expenses and taxes
kpis.signal: Decline in net income due to higher interest expenses and one-time charges

kpis.name: Net Margin
kpis.explanation: Net margin as a percentage of revenue
kpis.description: Net margin represents net income as a percentage of net revenue
kpis.signal: Slight contraction in net margin compared to the prior year

kpis.name: Operating Expenses
kpis.description: Operating expenses include selling, general and administrative expenses, as well as amortization
kpis.signal: Increase in operating expenses due to investments in internal resources and amortization from the Intramed Plus acquisition
